messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're targeting a quiet launch for eu-west-5 (small cohort) the week of May 12. Need final partner quota + hardware entitlement from Zircon and SI test window from BlueForge.

raj: +1. What's the exact capacity we should reserve? I can ask platform to pin a small pool.

maya: Thinking initial capacity: 4 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs (burst to 8), marketplace SKU mapping, and 2 private-VPC nodes for pilot customers.

elaine: Legal needs the joint announcement language before we ship. Can we keep it internal-only for the first 2 weeks? That reduces compliance gating.

sandeep: From infra side: we need partner-signed firmware certs for Zircon nodes and BlueForge to complete end-to-end perf tests. ETA from them?

adriana: I pinged Zircon yesterday — they said firmware signoff by next Tue if we provide the test matrix. I also asked BlueForge to calendar a 24–48h integration test window the week of May 5.

maya: Great. I'll drop the test matrix in the thread. It's minimal: prefix warm-up, 1k concurrent small prompts, 200 concurrent chat sessions, and KV-cache recovery after restart.

maya: ```
Test matrix (summary)
- prefix warm-up: 5000 tokens/session, 10 sessions
- concurrency: 1k QPS small prompts (<=64 tokens)
- chat load: 200 sessions w/kv-cache enabled
- restart/upgrade: simulate node reboot and validate KV resume
```

raj: Platform can reserve the pool once partners confirm firmware. I'll open the reservation ticket and tag eng-sre.

partners-bot: Reservation ticket created: #RES-4821 — assigned to @raj and @sandeep. ETA provisioning: 48–72 hours after confirmation.

elaine: Legal ok with quiet internal announcement + partner-only comms. Need final partner legal names and logo usage notes. Adriana can share.

adriana: Zircon provided logo guidelines and approved use for partner pilot. BlueForge requires a short NDA amendment (one paragraph) for co-marketing during pilot. I can route to legal today.

sandeep: One ops note — KMS integration needs a key policy change for the private VPC nodes. Security review Monday will cover it but flagging now.

maya: Timeline check: May 5 — integration tests w/BlueForge. May 7 — firmware cert in hand. May 9 — platform reservation done. May 12 — quiet pilot live (invite-only).

raj: I can get SRE on standby for May 9–13. Will also prepare a rollback plan in case Zircon image causes perf regressions.

elaine: For announcement: we will do internal comms May 13, external press only after pilot completes. Legal to review draft by May 10.

adriana: FYI billing needs SKU mapping from partnerships — please provide mapping for: reserved-gpu-a100.euw5, burst-gpu-a100.euw5, private-node.euw5.

maya: SKU mapping: reserved-gpu -> reserved-a100-euw5, burst -> burst-a100-euw5, private-node -> private-euw5. I'll send a short CSV to billing.

sandeep: Ops checklist added to the ticket (#RES-4821): firmware cert, KV cache test, KMS keypolicy, SKU mapping, legal NDA.

maya: If everyone agrees, I'll consolidate into a short playbook and share the read-only link: https://partners.redwood.ai/quiet-launch-euw5-playbook (internal). :thumbsup:

raj: Agree. I'll also add a capacity guardrail to prevent accidental over-provisioning during pilot. :eyes:

adriana: I'll route logos/NDAs to legal now. Expect confirmation by EOD tomorrow.

partners-bot: Reminder scheduled: integration test kickoff on 2024-05-05 09:00 UTC.

maya: Thanks all — tagging follow-ups: @adriana for legal/NDA, @raj for reservation, @sandeep for KMS/ops. We'll reconvene here if any blocker pops up.
